scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i out/frames/f%05d.png -vf scale=2560:1440:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 12 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/agniguard-demo-1440p60.mp4
scripts.encode:clean: ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i out/frames-nocap/f%05d.png -vf scale=2560:1440:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 12 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/agniguard-demo-1440p60-nocaptions.mp4
scripts.encode:draft: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i out/frames/f%05d.png -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/draft.mp4
